I just found an entire Tiktok account dedicated to showing a “3 month transformation” using this app of an AI GENERATED WOMAN. The AI “before” and “after” videos they are using to advertise this app is deplorable and pushes a false, unrealistic, toxic promise that will affect vulnerable young women. 

I’ve  never made an app review before, but felt it was necessary. disgusting

reviews.title: honestly, it's a scam.
reviews.text: i agree with the people who've said it's just a glorified checklist. the advertising on socials are very misleading and quite overblown. there are no resources for workout programs, no macros/nutrition information for meals, no evidence-backed professional advice. though there are some features i think have potential such as finding a community, inspiration board features you can add photos to, and some meal ideas, but the main feature is a checklist you make that you can check in on everyday to stay accountable. the subscription prices to even get access to everything is very disproportionate considering how little i got out of this app. at the very least, it should have a few days of free trial. if you are looking for something more than a accountability checklist app, i would look elsewhere.
